en.headline: Tai Po district councillor Peggy Wong resigns citing health reasons
en.dek: Wong Pik-kiu also stepped down from the Tai Po South Area Committee and as captain of a local care team; the government will gazette the vacancy.
body: Tai Po District Councillor Peggy Wong Pik-kiu has resigned her seat and related community posts, citing health reasons, the government announced on Saturday.

Wong, a directly elected member for the Tai Po South constituency and a long-standing member of the Democratic Alliance for the Betterment and Progress of Hong Kong, also resigned as a member of the Tai Po South Area Committee and as captain of the Tai Po Kwong Fuk and Plover Cove sub-district Care Team.

Secretary for Home and Youth Affairs Alice Mak said Wong had served the district for many years and that she respected the decision. The government will publish a Gazette notice declaring the seat vacant with effect from 26 September under the District Councils Ordinance.
The DAB issued a statement saying it respected Wong’s decision, thanked her for long service to the community and wished her a speedy recovery.

zh.headline: 大埔區議員黃碧嬌以健康理由辭職
zh.dek: 黃碧嬌同時辭去大埔南分區委員會委員及關愛隊隊長職務，政府稍後刊憲宣布議席出缺。
body: 政府周六表示，大埔區議員黃碧嬌以健康理由辭去區議員席位，並同時辭去大埔南分區委員會委員及大埔廣福及寶湖小隊關愛隊隊長職務。
黃碧嬌是民建聯成員，直接選舉產生的大埔南選區議員。民政及青年事務局局長麥美娟表示，黃碧嬌服務地區多年，尊重其決定。
政府將按《區議會條例》規定，稍後在憲報刊登公告，宣布有關區議員席位自9月26日起出現空缺。
民建聯發表聲明，表示尊重黃碧嬌的決定，感謝她長期服務社區，並祝願早日康復。
